quote_original: They were enormous wooden gates with high, high walls.
context_before: “I stood before Jerusalem’s gates.
context_after: I was so thrilled to be there, but my thrill quickly vanished when I realized that the gates were closed. Then I found myself on a high hill, clothed in a body of light, which radiated from me in all directions. Then I began this terrific struggle to return to my earthly body, for I wanted to share what I had experienced.”

quote_original: Believe me when I tell you: everyone must face their monster and their heavenly being, for no one is devoid of lovely thoughts.
context_before: , but one day it will be turned up, and you will know a creative power greater than anything you could ever imagine while your imagination is divided.
context_after: The love you felt for your mother when you were a child, or when you gave from the heart – these are the acts that go into making your lovely ideal.
